models.supportTickets: Customer support tickets from users needing help with the platform.
models.disputes: Formal disputes between parties requiring mediation and resolution.
models.complianceAlerts: AML, fraud, and risk alerts flagged for compliance review.
models.auditLogs: Immutable record of all administrative actions on the platform.
models.regulatoryReports: Scheduled and ad-hoc reports submitted to regulatory authorities.
models.gdprRequests: Data subject requests under GDPR privacy regulations.
models.featureFlags: Feature toggles for controlling rollout and A/B testing.
models.services: Platform services and their current health status.
models.adminUsers: Platform administrators, compliance officers, and support staff.
models.accessRoles: Three system-defined access roles (Admin, Standard User, Invitee) that set ceiling permissions.
models.contextualRoles: Scope-specific roles (Federation President, Association Treasurer, Circle Organizer, etc.) that grant feature access.
models.featureRegistry: All platform features organized by scope (federation, association, circle) with sub-feature hierarchy.
models.permissionOverrides: Individual user permission overrides that grant or restrict access beyond their contextual role.
models.permissionTemplates: Reusable permission configuration templates for common role patterns.
models.accessRequests: User requests for additional feature access with approval workflow.
models.rbacAuditEntries: Audit trail for all RBAC-related changes (role assignments, overrides, reviews).
models.periodicReviews: Scheduled access review campaigns for compliance.
models.sodRules: Separation of Duties rules preventing conflicting permission assignments.
models.permissionAnomalies: Detected unusual permission patterns flagged for review.
models.userPermissionSummaries: Aggregated permission profiles for individual users.

relationships: SupportTickets are created by Users and assigned to AdminUsers (agents)
Disputes are linked to SupportTickets and involve multiple parties
ComplianceAlerts may reference Users and/or Transactions
AuditLogs record all actions by AdminUsers on platform resources
GDPRRequests are submitted by Users and processed by compliance staff
AccessRoles define ceiling permissions for all users
ContextualRoles grant feature access within AccessRole ceiling at federation/association/circle scope
PermissionOverrides grant or restrict individual user access with justification
AccessRequests are submitted by Users and reviewed by scope-appropriate admins
RBACauditEntries track all permission changes for compliance
SoDRules prevent conflicting permissions (e.g., create + approve transfers)

supportTickets.subject: Contribution payment failed but money deducted
supportTickets.description: My January contribution payment for the Zurich Professionals Circle was declined, but the money was still taken from my bank account. The transaction shows as failed in the app but my bank statement shows CHF 500 deducted.

messages.content: My January contribution payment for the Zurich Professionals Circle was declined, but the money was still taken from my bank account.

Hi Elena, thank you for reporting this. I can see the transaction in our system and it appears there was a timeout issue. I'm escalating this to our payment team for immediate resolution. We'll refund the duplicate charge within 24 hours.
